findings.message: The change replaces the caller-provided context with context.Background(), which disables cancellation and deadline propagation. The function signature still accepts a context, but it is now ignored, leading to potential resource leaks and inability to stop in-flight requests when the caller cancels.
findings.suggestion: Revert to using the provided ctx parameter: http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, c.Endpoint, bytes.NewReader(body))

findings.message: Submitting events one-by-one in a loop is an O(N) I/O bottleneck. If `Submit` performs a network request per event, `SubmitBatch` will be extremely slow for large batches and does not leverage batching.
findings.suggestion: Modify `Submit` or create a new method to accept `[]Event` and send them in a single HTTP request (e.g., JSON array body) to reduce network round-trips.
